zones.name: Saltmere
zones.description: A walled trading town at the mouth of the Pale River. Tavern, market, Adventurers' Boards, temple. The party returns here between quests.

zones.name: Thornwood Approach
zones.description: Dense forest with branching paths. Hidden grove where Lyra can commune with the First Court. Bandit camps, herbalist outposts, a wolf den that's been acting strangely.
secrets: Hidden: first grove shrine fragment (triggers Lyra agenda reveal)
Hidden: Ironveil family crest half-buried near old oak
Scripted: Pale Thread cultist ritual site with fresh evidence

zones.name: Ashfall Crossing
zones.description: A ruined bridge town partially destroyed in the Cinderwar. Populated by survivors turned scavengers. Brann's squire Torin was last seen here. Undead arise at night.
secrets: Hidden: Torin is alive and held in the undercroft (Brann agenda)
Hidden: Silent Hand dead drop behind collapsed inn (Ossian agenda)
Scripted: Survivor who recognises Ossian from his guild days

zones.name: Ruins of Varek
zones.description: An ancient city swallowed by the earth. Three levels: market district, noble vaults, the deep archive. Act 1 macguffin — the Pale Compass — is in the noble vaults. Act 1 boss: the Archivist, a construct that catalogues intruders.

boss.name: The Archivist
boss.phase_3: self-destructs sequence — race against the clock

secrets: Hidden: Ironveil land deed in vault sub-room (Brann agenda completion)
Hidden: First Grove fragment sealed in archive crystal
Scripted: Pale Compass is cursed — one companion feels the pull

zones.name: The Gilded Dirge
zones.description: An opera house frozen mid-performance fifty years ago. The audience is still there — sort of. Mimic enemies disguise as companion dialogue. Heavy psychological horror tone.

boss.name: The Conductor
boss.phase_1: uses mimic enemies to impersonate companions, sow distrust
boss.phase_2: conductor fuses with the opera house — environmental fight
